item.description:

Flags and banners affixed to street furniture (e.g., lampposts, railings, highway trees, or road signs) without permission are prohibited. Hanging flags on lampposts creates major safety risks, driver distractions, and legal offenses because street columns are not built to hold extra weight or climber.

item.title: Derelict toilets and cafe, 5th August
item.description:
Everything wrong with this place. Aside from the extensive littering, flytipping and broken glass, dog poo and general sense of abandonment, there are NO toilets and NO cafe available to local residents or visitors. And STILL no paddle pool repaired for the children's playground. Every year you robbing bunch of idiots line your pockets with the profits from Soultown Festival, but every year NOTHING is fixed, replaced or made good. You're all so quick and forceful to charge and chase money from your residents, yet without providing basic amenities. I will not support your events in the park, as no profits ever get ploughed back into the rec. I will be complaining far and loud of all your failings. Disgraceful mismanagement and no doubt some level of criminal financial activity amongst you all too.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Village Way, Beckenham, Greater London
